name: snackshot-broker
description: LogMeal Access Broker: Firebase config, Firestore rules, Cloud Functions (WBS 3.x). See docs/Architecture/11 and 12.

scripts.test: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-snackshot --only auth,firestore "npm --prefix functions test"
